source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: the map has no hole numbers; which holes are South and their order were worked out from the scorecard lengths and the walks between greens and tees
unsure.8: the two published scorecards disagree on the back tee (465 or 420 yd); the photo measures about 420, so the GolfPass card was used
unsure.7: traced about 55 yd shorter than the card's back tee; a back tee further west may not be visible
